# Weft 1.0.8
- Pattern Pi setup now guides you through installing AWS tools, signing in, and getting your project settings with clear actions in Weft. - Weft checks Pi’s required settings and company sign-in helper before starting, and helps you install the helper if needed. - Failed or incomplete settings downloads preserve your existing settings. Sensitive settings stay out of setup errors and diagnostics. - Setup uses plain-language actions instead of asking you to copy commands, and startup failures no longer suggest reinstalling unrelated packages.
